title: SHIFT ABANDONED
body: You close the console in the middle of a queue.

There is no failure state in the game that punishes you for stopping - this is what stopping looks like. The shift simply continues without a reviewer, and the synthetics do not need you to approve them to move on.
Your run is saved. You can come back to it.
couldHaveDone: Come back. The save file resumes exactly where you left off, same applicants, same seed.
